provenance: Independent Canvas reconstruction of the complete studio showreel. Original logo and isolated photographic texture crops are attributed reference assets. All headline reveals, masks, strips, project cards, browser UI, cursor, notification, layer perspective, result counting, chart, final rings/domain/button are authored time functions. No original video or full-frame raster sequence is loaded. Reference audio is comparison only.
editable: Project palette and timeline; dedicated composition camera, artwork placement, masked typography, browser geometry and perspective layers.
reference_asset_policy: One isolated brand mask and individual static photograph textures only. No original video or original complete frame sequence is loaded. Result photographs have all original UI removed and locally filled; fills are approximate.
differences: Original footage contains drone, water, grill-hand and camera movement; isolated still textures with authored pan/scale do not recover these movements or original parallax.
Harbor exposure, forest texture masked into film lettering, vertical bridge artwork and some photo crop framing differ. Photo-derived result background fill has smeared architectural/food detail.
Font metrics, individual letter timing, card reveal timing and smear/motion blur differ; reconstruction uses OFL Geist, Archivo, Instrument Serif Italic and JetBrains Mono.
Perspective website layers use independently authored bilinear triangle meshes. Original perspective, specular detail, shadows, coast footage and exact layer trajectories are approximate.
Original soundtrack is included solely for comparison and is not independently authored.

portable_demo.textures: Original replaceable schematic assets; not the original reference artwork.
portable_demo.approval: Historical motion implementation; this portable demo is not user-approved.
